From: Elsa Martinez <elsa.martinez@acmeprocurement.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 15 Jan 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: SIG package for Acme RFP — OneTrust + Whistic

Hi Marcus,

We're finalizing the materials for Acme's vendor evaluation and need the completed SIG package sent through both channels you support: OneTrust (preferred) and Whistic (backup). Our Sourcing team wants: 

- A PDF export of the completed SIG questionnaire (single consolidated PDF)
- An evidence index mapping answers to attachments (CSV preferred)
- All supporting evidence files (SOC 2 attestation, encryption docs, policies) as separate PDFs

Deadline: Jan 28 EOD Pacific.

Can you confirm you can deliver both the OneTrust upload and a Whistic share? If OneTrust requires an organization ID or upload URL, please let us know and we'll provide access.

Thanks — appreciate a short plan and timeline.

Best,
Elsa Martinez
Senior Sourcing Manager
Acme Corp

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>

Date: Fri, 15 Jan 2027 10:05:00 -0800

Hi Elsa,

Thanks for the clear ask. Confirming we can support dual delivery (OneTrust upload + Whistic share). High-level plan and owners below:

1) Deliverables
- Consolidated SIG PDF (finalized answers + appendix) — draft by Jan 17, final by Jan 20.
- Evidence index CSV mapping question IDs -> file names + short notes — draft by Jan 16.
- Supporting docs (SOC 2, KMS diagram, encryption config, vendor subprocessors) — redacted SOC2 attached; rest uploaded separately.

2) Owners
- OneTrust upload: Marissa Cole (cc'd) will perform the upload and validate metadata fields and checksums.
- Whistic share: I will create the Whistic profile share and send link to your team.
- SOC2 redaction + final evidence sign-off: Neha Kapoor (security) will handle redaction and approve the attestation for sharing.

3) Request from Acme
- OneTrust org ID / upload token or a portal upload link (if possible). You mentioned earlier you could provide an org ID — can you share that?
- Any naming convention or required metadata fields for the evidence items (e.g., "Acme_QuestionID_Answer")?

4) Timeline
- Jan 16: evidence index v1 + draft attachments packaged
- Jan 17: SIG PDF draft (internal review)
- Jan 18: internal sign-off + OneTrust upload prep
- Jan 20: OneTrust upload + Whistic link shared with Acme

Attached for your reference: SIG_export_draft_20270115.pdf (initial export) and evidence_index_acme_v1.csv. These are drafts; final packaging will reflect Neha's redactions.

If anything on your side needs to shift the timeline, let us know; otherwise we will proceed to the Jan 20 delivery target.

Best,
Marcus Lin

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 16 Jan 2027 11:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: SIG package for Acme RFP — OneTrust + Whistic

Marcus / Neha — looping in operations details and checklist for the OneTrust flow.

Quick notes on the upload process (OneTrust):
- Preferred delivery is via org upload token (not manual UI) to keep audit trail consistent. If Acme provides an upload URL + token we will push the ZIP.
- Required metadata we will populate: document name, original filename, question ID mapping (custom field), upload date, uploader name.
- Checksums: we compute SHA256 for each file. If Acme needs a manifest file with checksums we will attach it as checksums_manifest.txt.
- File structure we will create in the ZIP: /SIG_PDF.pdf, /evidence/<files>.pdf, /manifests/evidence_index.csv, /manifests/checksums_manifest.txt

OneTrust quirks to call out:
- Some orgs require a "Document Category" field; if Acme requires it please confirm the allowed category values.
- Metadata field length caps: descriptions should be truncated to 250 chars.

Plan: I will prepare the ZIP and validate locally by Jan 18. If we have an upload token we will schedule the push for Jan 20 at 10:00 PT and notify Acme with the OneTrust document ID and public-facing URL. If no token is supplied we will do a manual upload and provide screenshots + doc IDs.

Neha: please ping when the redacted SOC2 is ready so I can include it in the ZIP.

Marissa Cole
Vendor Ops Lead | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
